title: Fair and Square: Design, Synthesis and Biological Evaluations of Squaric Acid Derivatives as Novel HDAC8 Inhibitors.
authors: Long, Nathan; Meyer-Almes, Franz-Josef; Kopranovic, Aleksandra; Wren, Stephen P
one_liner_zh: 该文研究HDAC8抑制剂的设计合成与生物评价，属于小分子-蛋白互作，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA体系无关。
abstract: Histone deacetylase 8 (HDAC8) is a clinically validated target in neuroblastoma, where isoform selective inhibition offers a strategy to suppress tumour growth while limiting off-target toxicity. Hydroxamic acids remain the dominant zinc-binding group (ZBG) in HDAC inhibitors but are also associated with metabolic instability, suboptimal pharmacokinetics and nonspecific metal chelation. In this study, we report the biological evaluation of a focussed library of 51 squaric acid derivatives as alternative, non-hydroxamic HDAC inhibitors. While a subset of these compounds has been described previously in a synthetic context, their HDAC inhibitory activity and selectivity have not been reported to date. The compounds organised into four structural subfamilies were screened against HDAC8 with moderate isoform selectivity. Structure activity relationships, supported by molecular docking and in silico techniques, highlight the influence of substitution pattern, electronic properties and molecular rigidity on HDAC8 inhibition. Collectively, these findings establish squaric acid derivatives as a viable non-hydroxamic acid scaffold for the development of selective HDAC inhibitors.
abstract_zh: 组蛋白去乙酰化酶8（HDAC8）是神经母细胞瘤中经临床验证的靶点，其中亚型选择性抑制提供了一种抑制肿瘤生长同时限制脱靶毒性的策略。异羟肟酸仍是HDAC抑制剂中占主导地位的锌结合基团（ZBG），但也与代谢不稳定性、次优药代动力学和非特异性金属螯合相关。在本研究中，我们报告了一个由51种方酸衍生物组成的聚焦库作为替代性非异羟肟酸HDAC抑制剂的生物学评估。尽管这些化合物中的一部分此前已在合成背景下被描述，但其HDAC抑制活性和选择性至今尚未被报道。这些化合物分为四个结构亚家族，针对HDAC8进行了筛选，表现出中等程度的亚型选择性。结构-活性关系，辅以分子对接和计算机模拟技术，突显了取代模式、电子性质和分子刚性对HDAC8抑制的影响。总体而言，这些发现确立了方酸衍生物作为开发选择性HDAC抑制剂的可行非异羟肟酸骨架。
